qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary fast-fashion apparel; purchases are deferrable and non-essential during economic downturns, highly vulnerable to fashion cycle shifts and low-cost substitution.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Western Need). Fast-fashion apparel is discretionary, deferrable, and easily forgone during economic downturns. H&M lacks Lindy brand equity or mission-critical utility, facing severe competitive substitution from ultra-fast-fashion platforms (Shein, Temu) and agile near-sourced peers (Zara).
qualitative.evidence: H&M operates over 4,000 stores globally in fast fashion. When inflation and cost-of-living pressures squeezed European consumers in 2022-2024, sales stalled and operating margins compressed to 6-8%, requiring heavy promotional markdowns to clear seasonal inventory. Discretionary, trend-driven fashion fails Gate 2.
